single_purpose: MemeDrop helps users create and insert meme replies on X/Twitter and LinkedIn.
short_description: Create context-aware meme replies on X and LinkedIn.
detailed_description: MemeDrop suggests relevant meme replies for posts on X/Twitter and LinkedIn, generates short readable captions, and lets users insert selected memes from the extension UI.

permission_justifications.storage: Stores a random anonymous install ID and local extension preferences.
permission_justifications.https://x.com/*: Runs the content script on X so users can insert selected meme replies.
permission_justifications.https://twitter.com/*: Runs the content script on Twitter/X so users can insert selected meme replies.
permission_justifications.https://www.linkedin.com/*: Runs the content script on LinkedIn so users can insert selected meme comments.
permission_justifications.api_host: Sends selected source-post context and meme actions to the MemeDrop backend for suggestions, captions, saved library, feedback quality signals, and deletion/export requests.

data_disclosures.tweet_text_or_compose_context: Source-post text is sent to the backend only when generating meme suggestions or captions.
data_disclosures.anonymous_install_id: Stored in Chrome extension storage and sent to the backend to separate saved library and usage data by browser install.
data_disclosures.usage_events: Sent to the backend to improve ranking quality and personalization, including shown, clicked, inserted or used, saved, and dismissed meme events.
data_disclosures.saved_meme_images: Stored when the user saves meme images to their library.

screenshots.description: Suggestion panel showing meme recommendations on X.
Popup library with saved memes and data deletion control.
